purpose: Composes a base preset configuration with a probed frames-per-second value to produce a fully resolved configuration. Validates overrides against allowed base-30 fields, scales constants and thresholds to the target fps, and converts timing values to frame counts.

public_api.name: resolve
public_api.role: Accepts a base config and fps value, validates field overrides, scales all fps-dependent parameters (constants, thresholds, frame counts), and returns a concrete ResolvedAnnotatorConfig. Caller must have already probed fps; this function never defaults it.
